cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

mechanism: Copy removal of display icing as an earned taste, then redefine equal portions to keep that prior food advantage.
confusable: Not merely a baker claiming wages: B2 must expose why the copied removal was not another person eating extra, and A3 must save face by inventing a fair category.
comparison: Food allocation and prior consumption instead of a race-start advantage.
seedUse: Retains equal portions plus already-eaten icing; gives the icing removal a specific misunderstood model.
